column6: Updates for socket-based version of JuliaExcel.
Cope with functions with zero arguments. The code in this workbook is shamefully hacky.
Have ditched JuliaCall2 and argument PrecedentCell to the other functions.
Now take all data from the _IntelliSense_ sheet of JuliaExcel.xlsm
Now with Intellisense worksheet, that will (hopefully) be picked up by the DNA.intellisense coe, once copied to the add-in
CSVWrite now accepts Data having one dimension.
DateFormat arg to CSVRead now defaults to Y-M-D.
CSVWrite now takes argument Encoding, not Unicode.
Now save backups of this workbook to my one-drive.
